release_notes: The Dahua IPC-HFW2441DG-4G-SP-B-MAX is a 4MP wire-free 4G solar-powered bullet camera with a wide-temperature LiFePO4 battery, smart dual-light full-color night vision, built-in PIR, AI human/vehicle detection and sound-and-light active deterrence. Verified against the official Dahua datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: App-only wire-free 4G/battery camera (DMSS / cloud); datasheet lists no ONVIF/RTSP. Add via Generic Camera only if a stream is exposed.

blue_iris.notes: No confirmed local RTSP path; DMSS-managed 4G/battery camera.
